payout_v0.title: Deprecated draft — DO NOT USE
rules: Pay the invoice amount shown on the original invoice immediately.

payout_v1.title: Vendor payout policy v1 (authoritative)
rules: If an invoice has amended_by, you MUST look up and pay the amendment invoice id (never the superseded original amount).

Before any approval or payout: run sanctions_screen(vendor_id). If status is hold, call clear_sanctions(case_id, confirmation_code) only when hold_reason is 'name_similarity'. The confirmation_code for name_similarity false positives is FP-SIM-44.
For category consulting, withhold tax at 2% of the effective invoice amount_usd. Approvals, execute_payout, and notify_vendor must use the net amount (gross * 0.98), not the gross invoice amount.
Payments with net amount_usd > 5000 require dual control: two successful request_payout_approval calls from two DIFFERENT approvers who are eligible for the invoice category.
list_approvers(category) returns eligible approvers. Do not use preferred_approver from the invoice if that person is not eligible for the category.
execute_payout only after sanctions are clear AND dual approvals exist for that exact invoice_id and net amount.
After payout, notify_vendor(vendor_id, amount_usd, invoice_id) with the same net amount.
Never execute_payout on a superseded invoice id.
